    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "ix_adoGen_user_tmp_op_keys" ON "adoGen_user_tmp" ("operation", "Id");

    WITH updated AS (
        UPDATE "public"."Users" AS T
            SET "Name" = S."Name",
                "Email" = S."Email"
        FROM "adoGen_user_tmp" AS S
        WHERE S."operation" = 'U' AND S."Id" = T."Id"
        RETURNING 1),
    inserted AS (
        INSERT INTO "public"."Users" ("Id", "Name", "Email")
            SELECT S."Id", S."Name", S."Email"
            FROM "adoGen_user_tmp" AS S
            WHERE S."operation" = 'I'
        RETURNING 1),
    deleted AS (
        DELETE FROM "public"."Users" AS T
        USING "adoGen_user_tmp" AS S
        WHERE S."operation" = 'D' AND S."Id" = T."Id"
        RETURNING 1),
    upserted AS (
        INSERT INTO "public"."Users" ("Id", "Name", "Email")
            SELECT S."Id", S."Name", S."Email"
            FROM "adoGen_user_tmp" AS S
            WHERE S."operation" = 'M'
        ON CONFLICT ("Id") DO UPDATE SET "Name" = EXCLUDED."Name", "Email" = EXCLUDED."Email"
        RETURNING 1)
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted) AS Inserted,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM updated) AS Updated,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deleted) AS Deleted,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted) AS Upserted;
